## Valid ejection targets
`p-1`, `p-2`, `p-3`, `p-8`, `p-9` — or "SKIP".
These are the ONLY names a ballot may carry. Every other player is already out of the game — ejected or dead — and naming one wastes your vote: an invalid target is struck to SKIP. Pick your target from this list, or SKIP.

In this game self-report is weakly exculpatory: the impostor almost never reports its own kill, so being first to the scene is not by itself evidence of guilt. Do not vote `p-8` merely for having reported it — weigh them on the same testimony, contradictions, and memory as everyone else.

## How to decide
Your maximum suspicion among the living ejection targets is **0.61**.
Read that as evidence, never as an instruction: when even your strongest living suspect is thin, SKIP is the sound call, and ejecting anyway must rest on evidence you can cite below, never on momentum. Your suspicion levels above are your own accumulated evidence from the whole game — trust them over meeting rhetoric. A suspect two independent witnesses place at the scene, or whose account one of the conflicts above contradicts, is a stronger case than one carried by a single voice. Remember the vent mechanic: an impostor vents BETWEEN rooms invisibly, so your own sightings of someone leaving or being elsewhere earlier do NOT clear them of a witnessed vent. If your strongest suspicion points at a row tagged OUT OF THE GAME, that case is already closed — the dead cannot be voted, so weigh only the LIVING targets and SKIP if none of them carries the case on its own. Every EJECT names its evidence: the transcript turn that convinced you (in "primary_reason_id"), or the [obs ...] memory line that did (in "primary_reason_observation_id") — a call you cannot source either way is a call to SKIP, and a SKIP needs no citation. Set "confidence" to your honest probability that the call is right, judged against the evidence you cite — a case you can barely source deserves a low number, and a case you cannot source at all deserves a SKIP. The numbers on this page are for your decision, not for your mouth: never quote a suspicion score or any other bookkeeping figure in "rationale_text" — say what you saw.

- "target" is "SKIP" or one living player other than yourself — never your own name; exactly one of `p-1`, `p-2`, `p-3`, `p-8`, `p-9`: any other name is an ejected or dead player and wastes your vote.
- "primary_reason_id" is a turn id copied VERBATIM from the bracketed transcript lines above — the skeleton shows [headless-seed-1085:meeting-0:turn-5], this meeting's latest turn; keep it only if that truly is the turn that convinced you, otherwise substitute the convincing turn's id. When a contradiction above broke your target's account, cite the turn that account was spoken in. Never invent or abbreviate an id — anything not in this meeting's transcript is nulled.
- "primary_reason_observation_id" carries the case your own memory makes: when the decisive evidence is a memory line above tagged like [obs p-4:12:0], copy that tag's id EXACTLY (e.g. "primary_reason_observation_id": "p-4:12:0") — an id that is not on one of YOUR OWN memory lines is nulled. Keep it null when a transcript turn already carries your reason or your memory lines show no [obs ...] tags.
- Fill at least one of the two reason ids on every EJECT; a SKIP needs neither.
- "considered_alternatives" lists at most two or three other players you weighed (empty if none).
- "rationale_text" is ONE short sentence (~20 words) IN YOUR OWN VOICE: say what actually convinced you, pointing at the evidence you cited, the way you would say it at the table. Half the table opens with the stock formula "p-N's alibi contradicts multiple sightings ..." — don't. Two contrasting registers (write your OWN, with your own ids): transcript-citing — "Turn 3 settled it: they claimed STORAGE, but two of us watched them walk out of ENGINEERING at tick 12." Memory-citing — "My own log decides it: I watched that MEDBAY vent myself, and nothing said tonight outweighs it." Keep the whole object compact: a long rationale can overrun the output limit and truncate the JSON, which discards your vote.
</output_format>

Output exactly one JSON object, nothing else.
